title: 海水淡化取水工程
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection
summary: 本課由淡化回收率推導取水需求，依序分析篩網法向流速、有效面積、管路損失及潮位吸入裕度，再比較地下取水、堵塞、海管浮力與生物暴露。最後將排放回流接回進水水質，要求每個算例保留控制體、單位及適用邊界，不將平均值直接當成生態或設備允收結論。
summaryEn: Starting from desalination recovery, this course develops intake demand through screen-normal velocity, effective area, losses and tidal suction margin, then examines subsurface collection, clogging, pipe buoyancy and biological exposure. Outfall recirculation closes the feed-quality loop. Every example retains its control volume, units and limits rather than converting an average into ecological or equipment acceptance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」與「接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification" and "Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「產水需求與取水總量」如何影響海水淡化取水工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Product demand and intake volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seawater-desalination intake works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 淡化廠取水量大於產品水量，回收率把膜系統產水與進水連結，預處理排泥、反洗及其他支流還會增加總取水需求。若只用產品容量選擇取水口，可能低估海管、篩網與抽水負荷；不同流程的回收率定義須明確標示是膜段或全廠，避免重複或漏算支流。本例只對膜段作水量守恆，忽略密度差及其他支流；不能把得到的進水流量直接當成全廠海水取水設計值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「產水需求與取水總量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A desalination plant takes in more seawater than its product output. Recovery links membrane product and feed, while pretreatment sludge, backwash and other streams can increase total intake. Sizing an intake from product capacity alone can understate pipeline, screen and pumping loads. Recovery definitions must distinguish the membrane stage from the entire plant to avoid omitting or double-counting side streams. The example applies volume balance to the membrane stage only, neglecting density differences and side streams. Its feed flow is not automatically the complete plant intake design flow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Product demand and intake volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「淡化廠標示的產品水容量就等於需要的海水取水流量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A plant’s stated product capacity equals the required seawater intake flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「產水需求與取水總量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Product demand and intake volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 淡化廠取水量大於產品水量，回收率把膜系統產水與進水連結，預處理排泥、反洗及其他支流還會增加總取水需求。若只用產品容量選擇取水口，可能低估海管、篩網與抽水負荷；不同流程的回收率定義須明確標示是膜段或全廠，避免重複或漏算支流。
knowledge.textEn: A desalination plant takes in more seawater than its product output. Recovery links membrane product and feed, while pretreatment sludge, backwash and other streams can increase total intake.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：淡化廠標示的產品水容量就等於需要的海水取水流量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A plant’s stated product capacity equals the required seawater intake flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「海水淡化取水工程」的「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「洪水量測與河道模型」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths” in “Seawater-desalination intake works”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Flood gauging and river model” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 淡化廠標示的產品水容量就等於需要的海水取水流量。
淡化廠取水量大於產品水量，回收率把膜系統產水與進水連結，預處理排泥、反洗及其他支流還會增加總取水需求。
篩網平均流速低就能直接證明所有海洋生物都不受影響。
optionsEn: A plant’s stated product capacity equals the required seawater intake flow.
A desalination plant takes in more seawater than its product output.
Low average screen velocity proves that no marine organisms are affected.
quiz.explanation: 淡化廠取水量大於產品水量，回收率把膜系統產水與進水連結，預處理排泥、反洗及其他支流還會增加總取水需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A desalination plant takes in more seawater than its product output. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「產水需求與取水總量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Product demand and intake volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45. Feed Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s and concentrate Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45. Feed Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s and concentrate Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 所有局部損失係數都可直接相加而不必核對速度基準。
地下取水只要量到一處高滲透層就能保證全廠長期供水。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。
optionsEn: All local-loss coefficients can be added without checking their velocity basis.
One highly permeable layer guarantees long-term supply for the whole plant.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「產水需求與取水總量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Product demand and intake volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。核對回收率的實際控制體，將膜段水量帳與全廠取水帳分開驗證後再合併。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows. Verify the recovery control volume and validate membrane and whole-plant balances separately against synchronized flow-meter records before combining them. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出膜段與全廠兩個控制體，分別填入相同產品需求和假設回收率。逐一指出尚未計量的支流，並說明哪些額外資料會改變海管容量估計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw membrane and whole-plant control volumes using the same product demand and assumed recovery. Identify unmetered side streams and explain which additional information would alter the intake-pipeline estimate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using membrane recovery as whole-plant recovery omits pretreatment water and understates intake pump and pipeline demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。核對回收率的實際控制體，將膜段水量帳與全廠取水帳分開驗證後再合併。
knowledge.textEn: Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows. Verify the recovery control volume and validate membrane and whole-plant balances separately against synchronized flow-meter records before combining them.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出膜段與全廠兩個控制體，分別填入相同產品需求和假設回收率。逐一指出尚未計量的支流，並說明哪些額外資料會改變海管容量估計。
knowledge.textEn: Draw membrane and whole-plant control volumes using the same product demand and assumed recovery. Identify unmetered side streams and explain which additional information would alter the intake-pipeline estimate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification"?
options: 以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
海管永久狀態穩定就代表空管施工或排空維修時也一定穩定。
optionsEn: Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Permanent stability guarantees stability during empty-pipe construction or drained maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「產水需求與取水總量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Product demand and intake volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using membrane recovery as whole-plant recovery omits pretreatment water and understates intake pump and pipeline demand. Higher recovery can also increase concentrate salinity, so it is not simply a one-directional intake benefit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只對膜段作水量守恆，忽略密度差及其他支流；不能把得到的進水流量直接當成全廠海水取水設計值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its feed flow is not automatically the complete plant intake design flow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「淡化廠標示的產品水容量就等於需要的海水取水流量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A plant’s stated product capacity equals the required seawater intake flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。
knowledge.textEn: Using membrane recovery as whole-plant recovery omits pretreatment water and understates intake pump and pipeline demand. Higher recovery can also increase concentrate salinity, so it is not simply a one-directional intake benefit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。
篩網平均流速低就能直接證明所有海洋生物都不受影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using membrane recovery as whole-plant recovery omits pretreatment water and understates intake pump and pipeline demand.
Low average screen velocity proves that no marine organisms are affected.
quiz.explanation: 把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using membrane recovery as whole-plant recovery omits pretreatment water and understates intake pump and pipeline demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接近流速與篩網面積」如何影響海水淡化取水工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Approach velocity and screen area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seawater-desalination intake works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 取水口附近流場包含垂直篩面的接近分量及沿篩面的掃流分量，兩者對生物暴露的意義不同。增加有效過水面積可降低平均法向流速，但局部堵塞、潮流與幾何不均仍會產生較高速度；生物保護還取決於物種、生命階段與孔隙尺寸，不能只用平均流速保證無影響。以下面積為有效法向過水面積，尚未換算成外框尺寸或考慮局部不均；假設流速只供計算，不代表任何物種或許可標準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接近流速與篩網面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flow near an intake includes approach velocity normal to the screen and sweeping velocity parallel to it, with different implications for biological exposure. More effective area lowers mean normal velocity, but blockage, currents and uneven geometry can produce local peaks. Protection also depends on species, life stage and opening size, so mean velocity alone cannot prove absence of impact. The area is effective normal flow area, not gross frame dimensions, and local nonuniformity is omitted. The assumed velocity is a calculation input, not a species or permit criterion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Approach velocity and screen area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設取水Q=1.20 m³/s、平均法向速度vn=0.12 m/s，所需有效面積Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume intake Q=1.20 m³/s and mean normal velocity vn=0.12 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「篩網平均流速低就能直接證明所有海洋生物都不受影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low average screen velocity proves that no marine organisms are affected." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接近流速與篩網面積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Approach velocity and screen area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 取水口附近流場包含垂直篩面的接近分量及沿篩面的掃流分量，兩者對生物暴露的意義不同。增加有效過水面積可降低平均法向流速，但局部堵塞、潮流與幾何不均仍會產生較高速度；生物保護還取決於物種、生命階段與孔隙尺寸，不能只用平均流速保證無影響。
knowledge.textEn: Flow near an intake includes approach velocity normal to the screen and sweeping velocity parallel to it, with different implications for biological exposure. More effective area lowers mean normal velocity, but blockage, currents and uneven geometry can produce local peaks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：篩網平均流速低就能直接證明所有海洋生物都不受影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low average screen velocity proves that no marine organisms are affected. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 篩網平均流速低就能直接證明所有海洋生物都不受影響。
篩網標示面積可以直接當成任何運轉狀態的有效過水面積。
取水口附近流場包含垂直篩面的接近分量及沿篩面的掃流分量，兩者對生物暴露的意義不同。
optionsEn: Low average screen velocity proves that no marine organisms are affected.
A screen’s labeled area equals effective flow area under every operating condition.
Flow near an intake includes approach velocity normal to the screen and sweeping velocity parallel to it, with different implications for biological exposure.
quiz.explanation: 取水口附近流場包含垂直篩面的接近分量及沿篩面的掃流分量，兩者對生物暴露的意義不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Flow near an intake includes approach velocity normal to the screen and sweeping velocity parallel to it, with different implications for biological exposure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接近流速與篩網面積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Approach velocity and screen area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設取水Q=1.20 m³/s、平均法向速度vn=0.12 m/s，所需有效面積Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m²。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume intake Q=1.20 m³/s and mean normal velocity vn=0.12 m/s. Required effective area Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m². Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以流場量測或核定模型分開法向與沿篩速度，覆蓋不同潮位、海流與部分堵塞情境。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate normal and sweeping velocities using field measurements or an approved model across tides, currents and partial blockage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設取水Q=1.20 m³/s、平均法向速度vn=0.12 m/s，所需有效面積Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m²。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume intake Q=1.20 m³/s and mean normal velocity vn=0.12 m/s. Required effective area Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m².

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設取水Q=1.20 m³/s、平均法向速度vn=0.12 m/s，所需有效面積Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m²。
淨正吸入水頭有正餘量就代表入口渦流與捲氣都不存在。
只要提高抽吸就能無限制補償濾床或地下取水層的堵塞。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume intake Q=1.20 m³/s and mean normal velocity vn=0.12 m/s.
A positive NPSH margin proves that intake vortices and entrained air are absent.
Increasing suction can compensate indefinitely for filter or subsurface-intake clogging.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設取水Q=1.20 m³/s、平均法向速度vn=0.12 m/s，所需有效面積Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume intake Q=1.20 m³/s and mean normal velocity vn=0.12 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接近流速與篩網面積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Approach velocity and screen area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以流場量測或核定模型分開法向與沿篩速度，覆蓋不同潮位、海流與部分堵塞情境。將有效面積、孔隙及物種調查一起核對，驗證局部峰值而不只比較全篩平均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate normal and sweeping velocities using field measurements or an approved model across tides, currents and partial blockage. Check effective area, openings and biological surveys together, evaluating local peaks rather than only the screen-wide average. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為同一取水量畫出均勻與局部堵塞兩種速度分布，指出平均值掩蓋的區域。將水理結果與特定物種證據分開列出，再說明兩者如何共同支持設計比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw uniform and locally blocked velocity distributions for one flow, identifying regions hidden by the average. Present hydraulic results separately from species evidence and explain how they jointly support design comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：篩網平均速度符合假設時，局部窄縫仍可能形成高速吸入或生物附著區；若把掃流速度誤當接近速度，生物暴露評估會失去正確方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local constrictions can create high-speed entry or impingement even when average velocity matches the assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以流場量測或核定模型分開法向與沿篩速度，覆蓋不同潮位、海流與部分堵塞情境。將有效面積、孔隙及物種調查一起核對，驗證局部峰值而不只比較全篩平均。
knowledge.textEn: Separate normal and sweeping velocities using field measurements or an approved model across tides, currents and partial blockage. Check effective area, openings and biological surveys together, evaluating local peaks rather than only the screen-wide average.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為同一取水量畫出均勻與局部堵塞兩種速度分布，指出平均值掩蓋的區域。將水理結果與特定物種證據分開列出，再說明兩者如何共同支持設計比較。
knowledge.textEn: Draw uniform and locally blocked velocity distributions for one flow, identifying regions hidden by the average. Present hydraulic results separately from species evidence and explain how they jointly support design comparison.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以流場量測或核定模型分開法向與沿篩速度，覆蓋不同潮位、海流與部分堵塞情境。
濃度乘取水量算出的生物數就等於已證明的死亡數。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Separate normal and sweeping velocities using field measurements or an approved model across tides, currents and partial blockage.
Concentration times intake volume equals proven biological mortality.
quiz.explanation: 以流場量測或核定模型分開法向與沿篩速度，覆蓋不同潮位、海流與部分堵塞情境。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate normal and sweeping velocities using field measurements or an approved model across tides, currents and partial blockage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接近流速與篩網面積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Approach velocity and screen area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 篩網平均速度符合假設時，局部窄縫仍可能形成高速吸入或生物附著區；若把掃流速度誤當接近速度，生物暴露評估會失去正確方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local constrictions can create high-speed entry or impingement even when average velocity matches the assumption. Confusing sweeping with approach velocity removes the directional basis needed for biological-exposure assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以下面積為有效法向過水面積，尚未換算成外框尺寸或考慮局部不均；假設流速只供計算，不代表任何物種或許可標準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The assumed velocity is a calculation input, not a species or permit criterion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「篩網平均流速低就能直接證明所有海洋生物都不受影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low average screen velocity proves that no marine organisms are affected." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 篩網平均速度符合假設時，局部窄縫仍可能形成高速吸入或生物附著區；若把掃流速度誤當接近速度，生物暴露評估會失去正確方向。
knowledge.textEn: Local constrictions can create high-speed entry or impingement even when average velocity matches the assumption. Confusing sweeping with approach velocity removes the directional basis needed for biological-exposure assessment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
篩網標示面積可以直接當成任何運轉狀態的有效過水面積。
篩網平均速度符合假設時，局部窄縫仍可能形成高速吸入或生物附著區；若把掃流速度誤當接近速度，生物暴露評估會失去正確方向。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A screen’s labeled area equals effective flow area under every operating condition.
Local constrictions can create high-speed entry or impingement even when average velocity matches the assumption.
quiz.explanation: 篩網平均速度符合假設時，局部窄縫仍可能形成高速吸入或生物附著區；若把掃流速度誤當接近速度，生物暴露評估會失去正確方向。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local constrictions can create high-speed entry or impingement even when average velocity matches the assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
